title: N. Korea seeks to cement permanent border as Seoul vows firm response: experts
caption:
Pyongyang is using border friction along the Demilitarized Zone to justify permanent military fortifications. By portraying South Korean warning shots as provocations, North Korea aims to cement the division of the peninsula into two separate hostile states.

Source: Koreaherald - N. Korea seeks to cement permanent border as Seoul vows firm response: experts
